name: Cheesy Mexican Zucchini Boats with Black Beans, Salsa & Tossed Salad

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the mixed greens if they came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
6 medium zucchini squash
3 orange bell peppers
1 ½ (142 g) pkgs spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.primary_message: Trim and halve zucchini lengthwise. Scrape out the soft flesh from the middle of each half, place in a large bowl, and set aside for later use.
Arrange zucchini halves, cut-side up, on a large baking sheet pan; drizzle with oil and season with salt and pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
½ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place zucchini boats in the oven and bake until starting to soften, 6-8 minutes.
Meanwhile, roughly chop reserved zucchini flesh and return to the bowl.
Drain and rinse beans. Add to the bowl with the zucchini along with salsa and spices; stir to combine the filling.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 (398 ml) cans black beans
3 cup salsa
1 ½ tsp cumin, ground
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Remove zucchini boats from the oven, divide filling between them, and top with cheese. (Wipe bowl clean with paper towels and set aside for later use.)
Return zucchini boats to the oven and continue to bake until flesh is tender, filling is warmed through, and cheese is bubbly, 10-15 minutes. Remove from the oven.
Meanwhile, rinse corn under hot water (from the tap) to thaw. Pat dry with paper towels and place in the reserved bowl.
Trim, seed, and small dice bell peppers. Add to the bowl with the corn, along with the mixed greens, and set aside.
Right before serving, add dressing to the bowl with the mixed greens and toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide zucchini boats and salad between plates. Enjoy!
